Appointments to External Boards and Committees.pdf
Recommendation:
Approve the appointments to the following boards and committees for the 2026-2030 term of Council:
Councillor Poisson be appointed to the Dog Pound Committee;
Councillor Gruszka be appointed to the Essex County OPP Detachment Board - North;
Mayor Bailey be appointed to the Union Water Supply System Inc. Board of Directors;
Deputy Mayor Walstedt be nominated to the Essex County Library Board;
Councillor Lahoud and Councillor Ruston be appointed to the Lakeshore-Tecumseh Inter-Municipal Committee;
Kelsey Santarossa be appointed as a representative of the Municipality of Lakeshore for the Francophone Association of Municipalities of Ontario until September 1, 2027;
The Executive Director, Infrastructure Services be appointed to the Essex Region Conservation Authority Source Protection Committee;
Mayor Bailey and Ryan McNamara be appointed to the Essex Region Conservation Authority Board of Directors until February 1, 2027 or such later date as prescribed by regulation;
Councillor Vogler be appointed to the Lower Thames Valley Conservation Authority Board of Directors until February 1, 2027 or such later date as prescribed by regulation; and
Mayor Bailey be appointed as representative of the Municipality of Lakeshore for the Great Lakes and St. Lawrence Cities Initiative, all as presented at the November 24, 2026 Council meeting.

Recommendation:
Approve Zoning By-law Amendment Application (ZBA-14-2026) to:
amend Zoning By-law 2-2012 as it relates to the subject lands legally described as Part of Lot 2, Concession East of River Puce, designated as Part 4 on Plan 12R11260, except Part 3 on Plan 12R22892; Lakeshore; and Part of Lot 2, Concession East of River Puce, Maidstone, as in R789031, except R348903; Town of Lakeshore, and;
rezone the subject lands from the Mixed Use Exception 28, Holding Symbol 21 (MU-28) (h21) Zone to the Mixed Use Exception 28 (MU-28) Zone; and
Direct the Clerk to read By-law 66-2026 during the Consideration of By-laws, all as presented at the November 24, 2026, Council Meeting.

Janitorial Services Contract – Two-Year Extension
1.
Janitorial Services Contract - Two Year Extension.pdf
Recommendation:
Approve the extension of the Janitorial Services Contract with Krautner Janitorial Inc. for an additional two-year term, from January 1, 2027 to December 31, 2028, in accordance with the extension provision included in the original agreement awarded by Council Resolution 12-01-2024;
Approve a 3% increase to all contract line items for the extension term; and
Authorize the Manager, Facilities and Parks, in consultation with the Executive Director, Community Services and Chief Financial Officer, to execute the required contract-extension documentation, subject to confirmation that service levels and pricing are acceptable to the Municipality, all as presented at the November 24, 2026 Council meeting.
